xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5473: docs: desktop app

narratives.Problem: Overdeck has no user page for the desktop app. Its facts are scattered across apps/desktop/, a partly wrong developer doc (docs/DESKTOP-APP.md: port 3011, a macOS-only menu, a working tray colour table) and two short sections in quickstart.mdx and configuration/remote-access.mdx. Planning also found desktop controls that do nothing (filed as #5556) and a pan up Linux bug (#5557).
narratives.Proposal: Add features/desktop-app.mdx with nine sections (download and install per OS, the @overdeck/desktop npm package, how pan up finds and launches the app, the tray and app menu, notifications, start at login, updates, opening another machine, getting help), every fact taken from code per the PRD's F-1 to F-39. Document only working behavior and link #5556/#5557 once where a control does nothing. Add the page to docs.json after open-in-overdeck, link it from four related pages, correct the stale facts in docs/DESKTOP-APP.md, and validate with mint@4.3.49 and lint:docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No code change: tray status, notification switches, Open Workspace submenu and Linux launch-at-login (#5556) and the pan up Linux candidate (#5557) are fixed in their own issues
- No screenshots (images/ has none of the app)
- No command palette, browser-dashboard updater or build/packaging content on the user page
- No change to anywhere.mdx, and no sentence changes in the four linking pages beyond one link or sentence each
- No changelog.d entry
- No description of tray colours, the dock badge, tooltip counts or the Open Workspace menu

autoDecisions.summary: One new page features/desktop-app.mdx placed right after features/open-in-overdeck in the docs.json Features group
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names the page path; open-in-overdeck is the closest related page and a one-line insert keeps the docs.json conflict with five sibling specs small.

autoDecisions.summary: Document only working behavior; name each broken control once with a link to #5556 or #5557
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires every claim to match current code; readers who find the switches in Settings need to know they have no effect yet, and the bugs are filed for the fix.

autoDecisions.summary: The new page owns the full open-another-machine procedure; remote-access.mdx keeps its summary and links to the page instead of the GitHub blob
autoDecisions.rationale: A user page should not send readers to a developer doc on GitHub; one owner avoids two drifting copies.

autoDecisions.summary: docs/DESKTOP-APP.md stays the developer doc; only its verified-wrong facts are corrected and it points to the user page
autoDecisions.rationale: Leaving known-wrong facts in the repo invites the next writer to copy them; a full rewrite is out of scope.

autoDecisions.summary: The macOS Gatekeeper step is conditional on the latest release still being un-notarized (implementation checkpoint IC-1)
autoDecisions.rationale: The v0.89.1 release log shows notarization skipped, but signing secrets may be added before the PR merges.

autoDecisions.summary: Filed #5556 (desktop dead surfaces) and #5557 (pan up Linux candidate) during planning
autoDecisions.rationale: Agents may file verified issues; the docs need stable links for the caveats.
